hooks.command: r=$(git -C "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || { echo "[WARN] destructive-git guard Git root unavailable, guard NOT active" >&2; exit 1; }; g="$r/tools/dev/check_destructive_git.py"; if [ -f "$g" ]; then python3 "$g"; else echo "[WARN] destructive-git guard script missing, guard NOT active: $g" >&2; exit 1; fi
